crash_bumper.physics: OpenRadioss bumper beam/pole impact; shell thickness scale and wall offset variation
crash_bumper.target_semantics: official target xyz is normalized absolute position; one-shot adds reference xyz to predicted residual; displacement is position minus reference
crash_bumper.normalization: positions and local features train statistics; global scalars and dynamic targets unnormalized in pinned recipe; per-field scaling needed for balanced multi-quantity experiment

crash_biw.physics: body-in-white crash; per-node shell thickness design conditioning
crash_biw.normalization: positions and local features train statistics

drop_phone.physics: OpenRadioss cell phone drop, modulus scales and rigid-wall orientation
drop_phone.normalization: position train mean/std; nonnegative dynamic target log1p(clamp(min=0)) then train mean/std; globals unnormalized; this transform cannot preserve signed strain

plate.physics: COMSOL quasi-static hyperelastic deforming plate/contact, not explicit impact demonstration

world_edges: nonmesh close-neighbor relative_xyz+distance repeated to edge8
boundary: next-step prescribed positions for type1/type3 at inference

plate.target_semantics: variable named velocity is per-step coordinate difference, without division by dt; stress channel invariant and units not established by loader alone
plate.normalization: coordinate increment and scalar stress use train statistics; position noise on movable nodes

sinter.physics: HP Virtual Foundry metal sintering deformation driven by temperature context

crash_generic.physics: generic crash reader/graph or point-cloud pipeline; user must choose actual bumper/BIW data and construct an experiment configuration

critical_cautions: Only bumper default directly includes equivalent plastic strain. Equivalent plastic strain is not total strain tensor.
Drop Von_Mises, plate scalar stress, and sinter coordinate targets must not be described as the same output.
AR and teacher-forcing Geo wrappers are position-only even if generic datapipe can load extra target fields.
Main crash VTP regex must be checked for integer time names; earlier compatibility fix preserved separately.
Model comparisons require identical split, physical units, output fields, support points, normalization and validation-based selection.
Source audit ran no training/FEM; actual execution matrices should link worker logs and metrics.
No prohibition on FEM exists in user scope; this subtask was source-only.
